name: Chicken Noodle Soup with Carrots, Onions, Celery & Parsley

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken in a single layer and cook, flipping once, until golden brown (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through), about 4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the chicken to a clean plate and set aside. Add more oil to the pot, along with onions and garlic. Cook, stirring often, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
6 sticks celery
1 lemon
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel carrots, trim ends, and cut crosswise into ¼-inch rounds. Cut celery crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Add both to the pot with the onions; continue to cook until fragrant, 2-3 minutes.
Add chicken back to the pot, along with broth, pasta, and spices. Cover and bring to a boil; reduce heat and let simmer until pasta and chicken are cooked through, about 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2839 ml chicken or vegetable broth
170 g rotini pasta
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp thyme

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, slice lemon into wedges and set aside.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Remove chicken from the pot using tongs and transfer to a clean plate or cutting board.
Shred chicken using two forks. Use one fork to hold the chicken and the other fork to pull and shred the meat. Add shredded chicken back to the pot and stir to combine.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Sprinkle parsley over top and garnish with lemon wedges. Enjoy!
